description: Draw names for a gift exchange in one call: everyone gives exactly one gift and gets one, never themselves. Rules: couples or families who must not draw each other, one-way rules (last year's pairs), and no two people who simply swap gifts (default). Optional wish per person, budget and gift day. Returns every pair and, for each person, a private link that shows only their match plus a ready message to send. The draw is cryptographically random and nothing is stored: it lives encrypted inside the links. Up to 500 people. For HR tools, party apps, chat bots and class or club websites. Free: 5 calls/day per IP. Paid: Radar API key (from €15/mo at https://radarbg.com/pricing#starter via X-API-Key) or $0.002/call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/secret-santa-generator.

date.description: Gift day, e.g. 2026-12-19 (links stop 45 days later)

event.description: Name of the exchange, shown on the reveal page

exclude.description: Rules: 'Anna, Ben' = nobody in this group draws another one of them; 'Anna > Ben' = only Anna must not draw Ben

names.description: People, 3 to 500. A wish can follow after |, e.g. 'Ben | coffee'. A text with one name per line works too

noMutualPairs.description: No pairs who give to each other (A to B and B to A)

privateLinks.description: Add a private reveal link and message for each person

name: secret_santa_generator
